claim: 15 communication-protocol specifications are formally model-checked (TLA+/TLC) with an active attacker in the model, covering capability grants, device pairing, onion routing, and device-mesh behavior.
attestation: The 15 specs carry explicit finite TLC instances and a pinned-toolchain manifest (tla2tools pinned by SHA-256), making them re-runnable rather than a spec pile. They live in the One Link private repository.
how_to_upgrade_status: Candidate for direct publication: model-checking specs reveal protocol *properties*, not implementation. Publishing the spec corpus with its pinned toolchain is under consideration. Counterparty verification: info@coherenceenergylabs.com.
limitations: Model checking verifies the modeled protocol at the checked finite instance sizes; implementation conformance to the model is a separate obligation.
